answer: Reaching the harbor of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on independent re-execution of receipts before any claim. The quill holds work receipts rather than names, so the beacon of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
